audit_items.proof_trace: Merkle inclusion proof validation is conditionally skipped when origin.is_from_el() returns true (ExecutionLayer path at L2176). BlobSidecar validates inclusion proofs unconditionally (L1955-1958), creating security inconsistency. If local EL is compromised, invalid data columns with mismatched kzg_commitments/body_root can bypass validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker compromises local execution layer or performs MITM on CL-EL connection, injects DataColumnSidecar with kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof that does not link to body_root. Consensus layer accepts invalid sidecar due to trusted ExecutionLayer origin, violating Merkle proof requirement.
